name: Tier List League
description: Run either group in order against a migrated backend. Set baseUrl including /api (default http://localhost:3000/api). Sign in through Discord as three distinct users and put their access_token cookies in local environment variables adminAccessToken, playerBAccessToken, and playerCAccessToken. Keep tokens local; sign in again if expired. Requests disable the cookie jar and select the player explicitly. Each group creates a separate game and captures IDs automatically. Regular game flow plays one hosted round per player and finishes with three joint winners on three points each. Points-target flow finishes at three points after one round, overriding the hosting quota. Only the first round is created explicitly: scoring returns each automatic next round. Hosts retrieve guesses for judging, retries preserve progression, and finalized guesses are revealed. Three players allow zero honorable mentions under max(0, floor(player count / 5) - 1). Settings lock at game start. timeoutDays sets the guessing deadline after host submission. These flows do not wait for deadline expiry; the local verification script covers that path.
